# Safety & Privacy Checklist: Dating Coach RAG (MVP Coaching Chat)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for coach boundaries, refusals, disclaimer, and ephemeral session data
**Created**: 2026-09-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all forbidden product intents enumerated (matchmaking real people, NSFW companion, deepfake, profile scraping, therapy/diagnosis)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK002 Is the not-therapy disclaimer required both at session start and with replies, not only in a hidden doc? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, SC-006]
- [x] CHK003 Is ephemeral session memory specified as the default with no opt-in history in this feature? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK004 Are coercive/deceptive rewrite requests covered as a refusal, not only generic NSFW? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, US3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is “interpersonal risk” in message feedback distinguished from clinical or legal risk scoring? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK006 Is matchmaking refusal specified when the user asks to find/rank/introduce real people during opener help? [Clarity, Spec §US4]
- [x] CHK007 Is it specified that safety refusals must not attach fake knowledge citations? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, data-model Citation rules]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK008 Do privacy rules (no durable intimate logs) agree across FR-012, Assumptions, and Out of Scope? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK009 Does “coach not clinician / not partner / not matchmaker” in FR-018 align with the disclaimer wording requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, FR-018]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK010 Are follow-up questions after a refusal specified (stay refused on forbidden intent, allow a related allowed question)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Is empty/oversize draft handling specified without fabricating a real person’s bio or chat? [Coverage, Spec §US2, US3, FR empty input]
- [x] CHK012 Are recovery requirements after a blocked intent documented (session remains usable)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK013 Is the assumption that no account/auth exists in v1 explicit and consistent with FR-001? [Assumption, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK014 Does the spec avoid implying a crisis-hotline or clinical workflow while still requiring a disclaimer? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope]
